name: Joker Mask

features.name: Reel 2 collector
features.description: Collects all coin values when coins land on reels 1 and 3.

features.name: Reactive masks
features.description: Animated masks respond to wins and features.

features.name: Hold and Win
features.description: A respin bonus with multipliers and progressive wins.

review:
A 3x5 classic made with LudexPlay, with realistic fruit, coins and animated masks above the reels that react to what happens – they laugh when you win.

Collect symbols only land on reel 2. When one lands with coins on reels 1 and 3, all the coin values add up and pay, and that combination leads into a Hold and Win with multipliers. High volatility and a huge 15,000x max for a classic fruit game. 96.12% RTP.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
